entry.title: He is half of my soul, as the poets say
entry.summary:
Author: To_spin_a_yarn

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 16,501Chapters: 3/?Kudos: 42

Summary: “My lord?” Gaius called. Arthur swallowed hard before turning around. “Yes?” he replied, his voice strangely neutral, far too clear for someone who felt as though his chest were being crushed from the inside. “I need you to tell me in detail what happened” the physician said. The effort to remain professional was obvious, to keep from showing the despair that must have been consuming him at the sight of his nephew in such a state. “There’s nothing to tell” Arthur said far too quickly, as though he wanted to end the matter before it gained any weight. “He was completely normal one second, and the next he was groaning in pain, with his eyes…” he made a vague gesture with his hand, unable to finish. Giving it shape would make it real, and he was not sure he could bear it. What difference did it make now? He’s dead, a cruel part of his mind whispered. “Then his eyes rolled back and he… fainted.” ⸻ Or: where Merlin’s soul travels back in time while fighting in the midst of the Second World War, and, in the process, his body in Camelot dies for a few minutes, sending Arthur Pendragon to the verge of fainting.

Summary: “Stop saving my life,” He ordered. He didn’t need Merlin, a druid and a sorcerer, rushing in to save his life every time he was in danger. He was a prince, a knight, he had been trained to fight and kill since he was a child. He didn’t need someone else running in to save him, and he certainly didn’t need someone else saving him using magic. Merlin tilted his head like he was actually considering it for a moment, then grinned. “No.” Arthur was starting to get the feeling that Merlin could probably beat Morgana on stubbornness if he really felt like it. *** Merlin grew up among the druids, learning his magic from the elders there, from the other magic users who filled the camp. When he was older, he left for Camelot, looking for a way to free his people from their persecution. And to find the blond haired boy magic had been showing him since he was a child.

entry.title: Reign of Bloody Time
entry.summary:
Author: BadAshWolf

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 19,013Chapters: 11/25Kudos: 44

Summary: For years, he carved lines into the earth and runes into his own skin. Now, it is time to crack both open and drag the future back to his King. But, as warned in the days of old, nothing is brought back without a cost. He is a king-maker who has outlived his sovereign; a warlock who has finally stopped bartering with words and started bartering with existence. He will pay any price if it means his heart never goes where he cannot follow him again. Merlin burrows to a past that hasn't yet bled, and is no longer the bumbling servant Camelot remembers. He is something older, hungrier, and powerful beyond measure. This time, Arthur will not just wear a crown; Merlin will carve him into a god to match his own dark divinity. And if it takes a little blood to bind them together, to ensure what he is owed, who he earned, then Merlin will gladly teach his prince how to thirst for it. A long time-travel fix-it, a terrible and magnificent Merlin, an Arthur remade, and the breathless cost of devotion.

entry.title: Whatever it Takes
entry.summary:
Author: Mimister

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 11,299Chapters: 5/?Kudos: 4

Summary: Merlin waits on the shores on lake Avalon for over 1,500 years for his king to return. His patience is suffocated by sorrow and he is drowning in grief, especially as he realizes that he is about to lose his friend once again as his memory fades and he can't quite remember Arthur's face.But then the king appears on the shores - lifeless and cold, a reminder for Merlin to keep going. Still the sorcerer refuses to do so and bends heaven and earth to bring Arthur back to life.Knowing that he did something inexcusable Merlin wakes 1,500 years past, Arthur by his side, the battle of Camlann just won. The price for the king's breath? The world's magic. Now, Merlin has to fight is feelings for the king, mend their strained relationship and is met by furious druids and sorcerers that demand magic brought back. Without it the world is succumbing to a sickness affecting animals, people and the world alike. Yet, the only thing that is truly important to Merlin is that Arthur stays alive. --First inspired by "What if I miss you for the rest of my life" by Janine Berdin.
